In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the KLOE tracking system is fully functional, stable and reliable.
He mixtures can be used for a tracking detector, with a performance comparable to the one of the conventional mixtures.
the He-based gas mixture, as used in the KLOE tracking detector, is a viable solution to the problem of tracking in the ϵ′ϕ experiment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the KLOE tracking system has been designed to cope with the requirements of the ϵ′϶ experiment and that it has been built and commissioned with the best possible quality.
a single cell drift detector with He-based gas mixture is feasible and that it is possible to achieve a good spatial resolution with a drift velocity in the range 50-60 μs/m.
the tracking chamber of KLOE is the largest ever built with a binary He mixture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the drift chamber of the KLOE experiment is the first one to operate in He based mixtures.

the drift velocity of He based mixtures can be controlled by varying the gas mixture, thus making it possible to operate the KLOE drift chamber at a drift velocity which is compatible with the DAΦNE bunch crossing rate.
He mixtures are not to be considered as a second choice, but they are a serious option for the design of tracking detectors in high energy physics.
